mapper.select: SELECT tenant.name AS tenant_name,session.agent_id::text AS agent_id,agent.name AS agent_name FROM public.nw_chat_sessions session JOIN public.nw_tenants tenant ON tenant.id=session.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_agents agent ON agent.tenant_id=session.tenant_id AND agent.id=session.agent_id WHERE session.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session.session_id=#{session}

WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (), reachable(run_id) AS ( SELECT run_id FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} UNION SELECT edge.child_run_id FROM reachable source JOIN edges edge ON edge.parent_run_id=source.run_id ) SELECT run.run_id,run.session_id,run.root_input_id,run.input_id,run.trace_id,run.span_id, run.agent_id,run.status,run.phase,run.created_second,run.created_nano,run.updated_second,run.updated_nano, COALESCE((SELECT max(event_sequence) FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_events event WHERE event.tenant_id=run.tenant_id AND event.run_id=run.run_id),0) AS execution_upper, COALESCE((SELECT max(session_sequence) FROM public.agent_runtime_session_events event WHERE event.tenant_id=run.tenant_id AND event.session_id=run.session_id AND event.run_id=run.run_id AND event.agent_id=run.agent_id AND event.end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM run.end_user_id AND event.target_kind=run.target_kind AND event.target_id=run.target_id),0) AS memory_upper FROM reachable JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run.run_id=reachable.run_id ORDER BY run.created_second,run.created_nano,run.run_id

SELECT 'EXECUTION' AS source,event.session_id,event.run_id,NULL::text AS action_id, event.event_id,event.type AS event_type,event.schema_id,event.canonical_json, run.input_id,run.root_input_id,run.trace_id,run.span_id,event.event_sequence AS sequence, event.occurred_second,event.occurred_nano FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_events event JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=event.tenant_id AND run.run_id=event.run_id AND run.session_id=event.session_id WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND
(event.run_id=#{bound.runId} AND event.session_id=#{bound.sessionId} AND event.event_sequence<=#{bound.executionUpper})
AND event.type=#{executionEventType} UNION ALL SELECT 'SESSION' AS source,event.session_id,event.run_id,event.action_id,event.event_id, event.event_type,event.payload_schema_id AS schema_id,event.payload_canonical_json AS canonical_json, event.input_id,event.root_input_id,event.trace_id,event.span_id,event.session_sequence AS sequence, event.occurred_at_epoch_second AS occurred_second,event.occurred_at_nano AS occurred_nano FROM public.agent_runtime_session_events event JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=event.tenant_id AND run.run_id=event.run_id AND run.session_id=event.session_id AND run.agent_id=event.agent_id AND run.end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM event.end_user_id AND run.target_kind=event.target_kind AND run.target_id=event.target_id WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event.event_type IN ('retrieval.performed','memory.written') AND
(event.run_id=#{bound.runId} AND event.session_id=#{bound.sessionId} AND event.session_sequence<=#{bound.memoryUpper})
ORDER BY occurred_second,occurred_nano,source,sequence

SELECT attempt.run_id,run.session_id,attempt.action_id,action.kind,action.target_handle AS target, attempt.attempt_id,attempt.observation_sequence,attempt.request_ref,attempt.result_ref,attempt.result_kind, source.action_id AS batch_model_action_id,invocation.provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(invocation.metadata->>'model',''),NULLIF(invocation.service,'')) AS model, invocation.invocation_id,invocation.started_at,invocation.ended_at AS finished_at, usage.prompt_tokens,usage.completion_tokens,usage.cached_input_tokens,usage.cache_write_input_tokens, usage.reasoning_output_tokens,usage.usage_source,usage.call_point,usage.ingested_at, (action.kind='MODEL' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_materials material WHERE material.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND material.reference=attempt.request_ref AND material.schema_id IN (#{modelRequestSchema},#{modelManifestSchema}))) AS diagnostic_available FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts attempt JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions action ON action.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND action.action_id=attempt.action_id AND action.run_id=attempt.run_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND run.run_id=attempt.run_id LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts source ON source.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND source.run_id=attempt.run_id AND source.attempt_id=action.batch_source_attempt LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT invocation.provider,invocation.metadata,invocation.service,invocation.invocation_id,invocation.started_at,invocation.ended_at FROM public.nw_external_invocations invocation WHERE invocation.tenant_id::text=attempt.tenant_id AND invocation.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id ORDER BY invocation.id LIMIT 1) invocation ON true LEFT JOIN public.observation_effective_model_usage usage ON usage.tenant_id::text=attempt.tenant_id AND usage.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND usage.session_id=run.session_id AND usage.run_id=run.run_id AND usage.root_input_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM run.root_input_id WHERE attempt.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt.run_id IN #{run} ORDER BY attempt.observation_sequence

SELECT budget.run_id,run.session_id,run.root_input_id,invocation.input_id,budget.attempt_id, invocation.invocation_id,invocation.status,invocation.provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(usage.model,''),NULLIF(invocation.service,'')) AS model, invocation.trace_id,invocation.span_id,invocation.started_at,invocation.ended_at AS finished_at, usage.prompt_tokens,usage.completion_tokens,usage.cached_input_tokens,usage.cache_write_input_tokens, usage.reasoning_output_tokens,usage.usage_source,usage.call_point,usage.ingested_at, invocation.root_input_id AS source_root_input_id FROM public.agent_runtime_budget_attempts budget JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=budget.tenant_id AND run.run_id=budget.run_id JOIN public.nw_external_invocations invocation ON invocation.tenant_id::text=budget.tenant_id AND invocation.attempt_id=budget.attempt_id AND invocation.operation_type='model.chat' LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT report.model,report.prompt_tokens,report.completion_tokens,report.cached_input_tokens,report.cache_write_input_tokens, report.reasoning_output_tokens,report.usage_source,report.call_point,report.ingested_at FROM public.observation_effective_model_usage report WHERE report.tenant_id::text=budget.tenant_id AND report.attempt_id=budget.attempt_id AND report.run_id=run.run_id AND report.session_id=run.session_id AND report.root_input_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM run.root_input_id AND invocation.root_input_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM run.root_input_id ORDER BY report.id DESC LIMIT 1) usage ON true WHERE budget.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND budget.category='AUXILIARY_MODEL' AND budget.run_id IN #{run} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts core WHERE core.tenant_id=budget.tenant_id AND core.attempt_id=budget.attempt_id) ORDER BY invocation.started_at,invocation.id

SELECT material.reference,material.schema_id,material.canonical_json FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_materials material WHERE material.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND material.reference IN #{reference} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts attempt WHERE attempt.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt.run_id=#{run} AND attempt.request_ref=#{request})
SELECT schema_id,canonical_json FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_materials WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reference=#{reference}

SELECT run.run_id,run.agent_id,run.input_id,run.root_input_id,run.trace_id,run.span_id,run.caused_by_event_id,event.canonical_json FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_events event JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=event.tenant_id AND run.run_id=event.run_id AND run.session_id=event.session_id WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event.session_id=#{session} AND event.event_id=#{message} AND event.type='execution.completed' AND event.schema_id='skillforge.runtime.execution.completed.v2'

SELECT attempt.request_ref,attempt.result_ref,action.action_ordinal FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts attempt JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions action ON action.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND action.run_id=attempt.run_id AND action.action_id=attempt.action_id WHERE attempt.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND attempt.run_id=#{run} AND attempt.result_ref=#{result} AND attempt.adopted=true AND attempt.result_kind='SUCCEEDED' AND action.kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND action.status='SUCCEEDED' AND action.selected_attempt=attempt.attempt_id AND action.request_ref=attempt.request_ref LIMIT 2
